Results.ReviewText:
I have been grilling since I was a teenager - so about 50 years!
I always used charcoal.  I swore by it.  Even graduated from lighter fluid to using a chimney and newspaper to light the coals.
Well, I got older and cleaning out the ash container and picking up 20 lb. bags of charcoal got to be too much.  I had to change the way I grilled.
So, my friend told me he bought a Weber - Spirit E-210 Gas Grill...and loved it!  We saw it and were very impressed!  Perfect size, and the store it came from offered free assembly and delivery - could not beat that.
So we went to look at them and guess what?  Yes, we bought it!  It was so easy to use.  Light the burners and within 5 minutes I was grilling.  First weekend did chicken and steak.  Both had that perfect "smoky" flavor.  I loved that I could easily control the temperature of the grill with the control knobs.  The thermometer built into the lid was perfect.  The cast iron grates were reversible so I had a perfect surface for either meats or fish.  Clean-up was easy and the drip pan is removable to aid in that purpose.  Can't wait to be able to continue grilling when the weather starts getting cooler. I totally recommend this grill!
Results.Title: Why Did I Wait So Long?

Results.ReviewText: I like the quality of the grill. And how fast the grill heats up.
Results.Title: Yes

Now, 8/2019, the flavorized bars are rotted with large holes, the caster wheels are literally falling apart and the burner tubes are provide fairly uneven flame.  The grill is cleaned and maintained, also barely used and always covered.  The cast-iron cooking grates work well and are very easy to clean.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill a couple of years ago and enjoyed it tremendously.   Works great and is very compact for storage on the deck.   Recently I had the propane tank filled at a local company and reconnected it to the grill.  It froze the regulator immediately when I turned it on.   I contacted Weber to buy a new hose with the regulator and they informed me that the tank was overfilled and that’s what caused the damage to the regulator.  They mailed me one for free even though I was out of warranty!   Hooked up the new one and it works like a charm!   Make sure your propane supplier weighs the tank to assure it’s filled appropriately

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
